rateLimits.note: Without a key. With a free key or prepaid usage: 30 a second; annual plan: 50. Semantic search: 1 a second; searches with more than 5 boolean operators: 1 a second keyless (5 with a key, 25 annual).

The keyless daily budget, $0.10 a day (help.openalex.org/access/example-costs), sent as x-ratelimit-limit: 1000 credits (x-ratelimit-limit-usd 0.1). A call costs: single entity by ID or DOI free, list + filter 1 credit ($0.0001), search 10 credits ($0.001), semantic search $0.001, content download $0.01. Resets at midnight UTC. A free key: $1 a day (10x, 10000 credits).

provenance.notes: Read on 2026-11-10: rate-limits-and-authentication, pricing ('records are released under a CC0 public-domain license'), example-costs and the API overview ('all data is CC0'). No key needed for basic use; a free key (api_key parameter) gives 10x the daily budget, usage tracking and cursor paging beyond the first page; a new account spends its first $1 at up to $0.10 every 5 minutes. The pages no longer mention a mailto / polite pool. A test call returned x-ratelimit-limit 1000, x-ratelimit-cost-usd 0.0001 and x-ratelimit-credits-used 1 for a list call. per_page max 100, basic paging up to 10000 results.
